Explanation: Creates an object that can open the computer's file windows.
Opens a window to pick a file to open. Returns the file or undefined if the person cancels.
Opens a window to pick a name and folder to save to. Returns the file or undefined.
Opens a window to pick a folder. It starts in the folder given by location.
Creates a list of file extensions that a file window should allow.
Adds a file extension to the filter. Leave out the dot.
If false, the window allows only the extensions in the filter. A new filter allows every file until you call this.
